title: Returns Casebook: Returned-Payment Fees in a Parking Catch-Up under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Rule.** The parking catch-up amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the parking returned-payment fee twice where two draft attempts for the returned parking due date settled and were returned, once where one settled and was returned, and nothing otherwise. Two or more such attempts add it twice. The attempts read are the draft attempts on the authorization for the returned parking due date (the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date) with an ACH settled result.

| Parking class | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $35.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical).**

1. Bluegate Uncovered Car Space; the original draft and its re-presentment both settled and were returned: $30.00 twice, $60.00.
2. Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage; only the original draft settled and was returned: $35.00.
3. Any class; no draft attempt for that due date settled: nothing.
